name: mushoku_do_over
about: Mushoku Tensei story Short: a recluse dies after 20 wasted years and wakes up reborn; he decides that if he tries as hard as everyone else and gets back up when he falls, maybe even he can do it - the drop opens his new life (Roxy, the storm spell, sword training, Sylphie, fire, the demon continent) and ends on him vowing to get serious about living.
song: /mnt/datadisk/song/MONTAGEM ALQUIMIA SLOWED - h6itam n7san7os Mc Menor Do Alvorada.mp3

story.why: I've been a recluse for 20 years
my life was basically over anyway
I get it, I've been reincarnated
my last life ended full of regret... if I get up when I fall, I'll be okay

outro.why: even a jobless, reclusive bum like me won't waste a second chance

title: He Wasted 20 Years As A Recluse, Then Got A SECOND CHANCE At Life
hook: 34 years old, jobless, never left his room. Then a truck, and a do-over in a world of magic.
